messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Talent Ops <talent-ops@talentpartners.com>, Finance Partnerships <finance-partners@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Executive headcount posture + shelfing guidance for QBR prep

Team —

QBR prep next week means we need to lock an executive-level posture on open reqs. The ask from Product & Sales leadership: a clear signal on which reqs we will approve, which we will shelf for the quarter, and a lightweight exceptions process for mission-critical backfills.

Quick context: hiring runway is tighter than we forecasted in September (revenue deferrals + infra spend). We still need to protect a small set of critical hires (senior infra, two CS leads) but should avoid opening new requisitions unless they are replacing net losses.

Please reply inline with: 1) green (approve), yellow (can be deferred/shelved), red (freeze); 2) one-line justification; 3) any blocker for Talent Ops to execute by EOD Friday. I attached a current matrix exported from HR (tab: active-reqs).

Goals for QBR slide: a consolidated table with approvals/shelves and a short rationale — I will own the slide.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: QBR_headcount_request_matrix.xlsx (worksheet: active-reqs)

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Talent Ops <talent-ops@talentpartners.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Executive headcount posture + shelfing guidance for QBR prep

Hannah —

Thanks for the clear ask. My quick pass below (pulling from the matrix):

- REQ-3421 (Sr Infra Engineer) — green. This is a one-for-one backfill following a departure; ops risk if we delay.
- REQ-3478 (Product PM, platform) — yellow. Important but can move to the backlog; not customer-facing this quarter.
- REQ-3502 (SRE contractor) — red. Replace with a short-term engagement via vendors if needed.

Justification: prioritize hires that materially reduce latency/cost or unblock enterprise deals. If Talent Ops can expedite REQ-3421 by EOD Thursday (we have candidate pipeline), we should approve it for offer. For yellow items I recommend we mark as "shelf — review in 30 days" rather than full cancellation.

Minor ask: can Talent Ops flag any reqs that are constrained by visa/start-date (I suspect REQ-3421 has a candidate needing early 2028 start).

-Markus

Hannah / Markus —

My updates after reviewing hiring queue and Finance gating:

- REQ-3421 (Sr Infra Engineer) — approved. Finance will cover the hire from the existing headcount pool; Talent Ops, please proceed with offer and secure start date. I attached the signed internal approval form for that req.
- REQ-3478 (Product PM) — shelf; Product agreed to a delayed hire cadence and will re-submit if priorities shift.
- REQ-3560 (CS Lead) — conditional green. Approve only if candidate meets Level 5 profile; otherwise hold.

Blockers: none on REQ-3421. For REQ-3560 we need a short evidence pack (candidate comp band + hiring manager justification) before Friday.

Thanks,

Squash (finalizing for the QBR):

- REQ-3421 — APPROVED (green). Talent Ops: extend offer, aim for 2028-01-08 start. Attachments: approval form on file.
- REQ-3478 — SHELVED (yellow, review Jan 15 2028). Product lead to provide reprioritization note if timeline changes.
- REQ-3502 — FROZEN (red). Use contractor pool for immediate coverage if required.
- REQ-3560 — CONDITIONAL (green if Level 5 candidate). Hiring manager must send evidence pack by Friday EOD; otherwise it will move to shelf.

Operational notes for Talent Ops & Finance: please update the central QBR matrix (Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QBR-Headcount-Playbook) and tag items with the Jira keys (HRREQ-3421 / HRREQ-3560). Finance will reflect the approved net headcount in the compensation forecast for Q1.

Hannah — I consolidated the language for the QBR slide and added a short "exceptions" process: one-page form (REQ-XXX) + approver list. I put a draft in the Drive folder; happy to iterate on tone.

Thanks all —
